title: Debt and Ghost
author: N. M. Montrose
blurb: August Nakamura, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
